_schema: Run29 s4 Phase-3 pairing (claude -p opus). PIVOT to modern non-craft domains; tests R16 (NARROW ceiling craft-specific or universal).

candidates.technique: Internalized Reasoning for Long-Context Visual Document Understanding
candidates.niche: Sequencing-run QC interpretation & rerun-eligibility judgment (domain A)
candidates.capability_gap: FastQC/MultiQC emit per-module Warn/Fail flags but explicitly punt the contextual decision: did THIS sample fail for THIS application, and is a rerun warranted. The judgment is reasoning over the visual QC report PLUS experiment context, not metric thresholding.
candidates.differentiator_justification: The technique internalizes page-relevance reasoning over long visual documents (plots+tables) — exactly the QC-report-plus-context read that no flag-tool does. Differentiator is contextual adjudication, which no metric tool provides.
candidates.preliminary_gap_guess: OPEN (borderline) — has_industrial_analog=no clears the application axis cleanly (no sibling app, no product makes the accept/rerun call). The only adjacency risk is the technique family (visual-doc reasoning) having generic report-interpretation siblings; if the probe finds no bioinformatics-QC ML adjudicator, this is the one true OPEN. Honest lean: NARROW under strict reading of technique-family.
candidates.search_probe: "sequencing run QC" OR FastQC "rerun" decision machine-learning interpret pass/fail context site:arxiv.org; and: bioinformatics core facility "rerun eligibility" automated model

candidates.technique: HOLOGRAPH: Active Causal Discovery via Sheaf-Theoretic Alignment of LLM Priors
candidates.niche: Foodborne outbreak hypothesis generation from trawling interviews (domain B)
candidates.capability_gap: After a cluster is flagged, epidemiologists abductively reconcile free-text recall across many sick people to nominate a likely vehicle. No deployed product does interview-to-hypothesis; PulseNet only handles upstream genomic clustering.
candidates.differentiator_justification: LLM-guided active causal discovery with hidden-confounder handling and Expected-Free-Energy query selection maps directly onto abductive vehicle nomination and 'which food to ask about next'. The method family is brand-new (Dec 2025) with no deployed sibling.
candidates.preliminary_gap_guess: NARROW — application axis is fairly clear (weak industrial analog, no product), but causal inference IS epidemiology's core method family (case-control odds ratios touch this exact problem), so the technique axis has a sibling. Strict gate => NARROW despite the niche being near-virgin.
candidates.search_probe: foodborne outbreak "vehicle" hypothesis generation LLM OR "causal discovery" trawling interview abductive; and: case-control outbreak investigation automated hypothesis machine learning

candidates.technique: A-RAG: Agentic RAG via Hierarchical Retrieval Interfaces
candidates.niche: Clinical handoff / SBAR salience-selection — what to hand off (domain B)
candidates.capability_gap: Even with SBAR structure, the human judgment of WHICH facts are important enough to transmit drives omission errors (~80% of serious errors involve handoff). SBAR/I-PASS are forms, not salience selectors.
candidates.differentiator_justification: Agentic multi-granularity retrieval over the chart could rank/select the salient handoff items rather than template-fill — a salience-selection differentiator no structured form offers.
candidates.preliminary_gap_guess: NARROW — application axis: none-as-AI today, BUT the technique family (clinical note/discharge summarization, EHR retrieval) has heavy siblings, and the industrial shift-handover analog exists. Both-axis adjacency => NARROW.
candidates.search_probe: SBAR handoff "salience" OR "what to communicate" LLM select; and: clinical handoff summarization model omission error reduction deployed

candidates.technique: ShapPFN (tabular foundation model with built-in Shapley attribution)
candidates.niche: Youth talent identification / projection beyond the scout's eye (domain A)
candidates.capability_gap: Forecasting which immature youth athletes will succeed is subjective expert judgment with poor inter-scout agreement and relative-age/maturation bias; no model decomposes the holistic projection.
candidates.differentiator_justification: A tabular FM that emits prediction + feature importance in one pass could decompose 'projectability' and expose maturation/relative-age confounds — the interpretable projection scouts can't articulate.
candidates.preliminary_gap_guess: NARROW — has_industrial_analog=no helps the application axis, but pro sports analytics is a strong technique-family sibling (same tabular/forecasting stack on in-game data, an adjacent app). Plus a hard data-access blocker (longitudinal youth outcomes are scarce). => NARROW.
candidates.search_probe: youth athlete "talent identification" projection machine learning future potential model; and: relative age effect bias correction model scouting

candidates.niche: SAR mission tasking & search-segment prioritization (domain A)
candidates.capability_gap: The IC's minute-by-minute call of which arriving resource to assign which segment — translating Lost-Person-Behavior probability into dynamic tasking and re-tasking — is manual map-work, not optimization.
candidates.differentiator_justification: A latent world-model planner is a natural fit for sequential resource-to-segment tasking under terrain/weather/clue uncertainty with dynamic re-tasking — sequential planning is the differentiator over static heat maps.
candidates.preliminary_gap_guess: NARROW — application axis is nearly clear (no industrial twin) BUT maritime SAROPS/SARPlan Bayesian search theory is a direct technique-family sibling on the adjacent sea-search app, and CalTopo 'probability-based heat mapping' is emerging adjacency. => NARROW.
candidates.search_probe: wilderness SAR "segment" tasking optimization reinforcement learning lost person behavior; and: SAROPS land search planning model deployed

candidates.niche: Ambiguous receiving discrepancy / damaged-goods exception calls (domain B)
candidates.capability_gap: At inbound receiving, accept/reject/quarantine on damaged or PO-mismatched goods is a worker judgment documented with photos+notes; WMS records but does not adjudicate.
candidates.differentiator_justification: Point-driven visual grounding could localize damage and tie it to PO line items, producing a reviewable accept/quarantine recommendation — visual grounding + doc cross-ref is the differentiator over WMS logging.
candidates.preliminary_gap_guess: NARROW — has_industrial_analog=no for the adjudication, but VLM visual-inspection/defect-detection is a massive technique-family sibling in manufacturing QC. Technique-axis adjacency => NARROW.
candidates.search_probe: warehouse receiving damaged goods "accept reject quarantine" vision model decision; and: automated visual inspection PO mismatch grounding WMS

candidates.technique: CANDI (Curated Test-Time Adaptation for multivariate anomaly detection)
candidates.capability_gap: Translating raw viral RNA concentrations into 'rising? real? what population? what action?' requires expert judgment because shedding/timing vary by pathogen and sewersheds don't map to populations.
candidates.differentiator_justification: TTA with false-positive mining and spatiotemporal normality adaptation matches the distribution-shift problem (shedding shifts, new variants) better than fixed thresholds — adaptation under shift is the differentiator.
candidates.preliminary_gap_guess: NARROW — environmental-sensor time-series anomaly detection/normalization is a known technique-family sibling, and Biobot/WastewaterSCAN/NWSS plus research Bayesian methods already touch the application. Both axes adjacent => NARROW.
candidates.search_probe: wastewater surveillance "normalization" anomaly detection model rising signal interpret; and: sewershed shedding burden inference machine learning

candidates.technique: LegalGraphRAG: Multi-Agent Graph RAG for Legal Reasoning
candidates.niche: Corporate-action free-text interpretation & elective-event decisioning (domain A)
candidates.capability_gap: ~46% of event data arrives as unstructured free-text offering docs with contradictory terms; firms independently interpret ambiguous terms and make discretionary elections. Vendors handle connectivity/lifecycle, not interpretation.
candidates.differentiator_justification: Hierarchical graph retrieval + Researcher/Auditor/Adjudicator verification fits ambiguous-term reconciliation across multi-document offering packages with an auditable election rationale — verified multi-doc reasoning is the differentiator.
candidates.preliminary_gap_guess: NARROW — document-to-structured-data extraction and contract/RFQ interpretation are strong technique-family siblings (has_industrial_analog=yes), and fintech vendors already tool the surrounding lifecycle. => NARROW.
candidates.search_probe: corporate action "free text" offering document interpretation LLM extraction election; and: ambiguous terms reconciliation RAG financial securities

candidates.technique: PMAx: An Agentic Framework for AI-Driven Process Mining
candidates.niche: Settlement-fail / reconciliation break exception adjudication (domain A)
candidates.capability_gap: ~15% of reconciliations break; ~90% of manual matching effort comes from non-standard data, and the root-cause cause-determination on each break is human judgment across confirmation/matching/settlement.
candidates.differentiator_justification: Closed-loop agentic process mining bridges process semantics to root-cause across the trade lifecycle with hallucination mitigation — automated cross-stage root-cause is the differentiator over rule-based matchers.
candidates.preliminary_gap_guess: NARROW — direct industrial analog (ERP/inventory reconciliation), and process mining is already applied to financial back-office reconciliation (technique-family sibling). Duco/SmartStream/HighRadius touch the app. => NARROW.
candidates.search_probe: settlement fail reconciliation break "root cause" process mining automated adjudication; and: trade matching exception machine learning cause determination

candidates.niche: Particle-accelerator online beam tuning by expert operators (domain A)
candidates.capability_gap: Online tuning across huge, coupled, sensitive parameter spaces is still done by hand between shifts; operators make structure-aware guesses that RL/BO optimizers lack.
candidates.differentiator_justification: Learning the Koopman/evolution operator of the coupled beam response is a distinct angle from RL/BO — a linear operator view of the coupled dynamics could give the structure-aware model operators want, differentiating from black-box optimizers.
candidates.preliminary_gap_guess: NARROW — RL/Bayesian-optimization 'autonomous accelerator' research (SLAC/DESY/KEK, Xopt/Badger) is a direct technique-family sibling on this exact application, even if not production-default. Both axes adjacent => NARROW.
candidates.search_probe: accelerator beam tuning Koopman operator OR "evolution operator" online control; and: autonomous accelerator Bayesian optimization reinforcement learning production

candidates.technique: Large Causal Models (LCMs) for Temporal Causal Discovery
candidates.niche: EMD acuity determination / over-undertriage tuning (domain A)
candidates.capability_gap: MPDS overtriages at ~62% (target 25-35%); right-sizing pre-arrival, phone-only ambulance acuity with no patient exam resists pure protocol or pure ML.
candidates.differentiator_justification: A temporal causal foundation model over dispatch→on-scene-outcome could recalibrate protocol determinants and expose which call features causally drive over/undertriage — causal recalibration is the differentiator over deterministic cards.
candidates.preliminary_gap_guess: NARROW — predictive triage in clinical ED is a technique-family sibling (has_industrial_analog=partial), and safety-criticality of dispatch keeps a human arbiter (addressed-and-constrained). => NARROW, with a safety blocker reinforcing it.
candidates.search_probe: emergency medical dispatch MPDS overtriage model acuity machine learning; and: pre-arrival ambulance priority prediction causal calibration

candidates.technique: ShapPFN (tabular foundation model with built-in Shapley attribution)
candidates.capability_gap: Underwriters allocate shares using discretion beyond the bid (relationship, perceived info quality), so identical bids get different allocations; this is deliberately human/relational.
candidates.differentiator_justification: A transparent allocation-scoring model with attribution could surface implicit relationship/info-rent weightings — but the gap is intentional, not a tooling gap.
candidates.preliminary_gap_guess: CLOSED — the allocation call is kept human by design for relational/information-rent reasons (addressed-and-declined). No product attempts it precisely because discretion is the point; not a capability gap. => CLOSED.
candidates.search_probe: IPO bookbuilding allocation discretion algorithm model relationship; and: underwriter share allocation automation regulatory discretion
